items.summary: Disposition: blocked, with counsel_required data uses. Keep SearchWoot private; do not authorize bounded public beta, affiliate/advertising expansion, or rights outreach. Ordinary reversible growth that adds no new data collection, credentials, permissions, dependencies, or public exposure may continue elsewhere.

The smallest next evidence action is to attach one dated bundle covering the four open legal tasks, then route unresolved rights, personal-data, notification, vendor, and jurisdiction questions to human counsel.
